reuse.why: Follows the existing link.ensureAccountIsNotLinked guard pattern with a sibling guard in link.ts; the two guards are not combined into one shared link precondition.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the one-line guard call is repeated in the six provider link functions, mirroring the existing guard.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/link.ts next to ensureAccountIsNotLinked and runs before any bank lookup or write.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six calls and unit tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear and single-sourced; a new provider must remember to add both guard calls.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link function calls link.ensureAccountIsOpen alongside link.ensureAccountIsNotLinked.

one_place.where: link.ensureAccountIsOpen in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by all six provider link functions in accounts/app.ts.
